description: Frozen confirmatory protocol v1 for the workload-heterogeneity pilot. One frozen contract definition (unit floors), the canonical Java allocation/installation/execution path, fallback disabled, all seven policies, all seven workload regimes, two contention levels, 200 fresh confirmatory seeds per cell from a new deterministic namespace with no overlap with canonical or exploratory seeds or task-workload hashes. The same task workload is paired across contention; the same scenario is paired across policies. Primary policy: joint Leontief. Co-primary cells: Dirichlet 0.1 at both contention levels. This configuration is preregistered and must not be edited after confirmatory results are generated.
success_rule: For the primary policy (joint_leontief) in BOTH co-primary cells separately, using queue-order completion: (1) mean completion higher than DRF; (2) paired 95% bootstrap interval for Leontief minus DRF strictly above zero; (3) point estimate at least 1.0 additional completed task per 48-task run; (4) no increase in the observed zero-completion fraction relative to DRF; (5) capacity, bound, fallback, and infeasibility counts all zero. A pooled interval cannot substitute for failure in one co-primary cell. Locally-optimized completion is a required robustness result that controls interpretation but is not part of the formal success rule.
